descriptions.d20c_hud_meter_update_800f0a70: Poll the meter timers (+104, +100) and scale the texture size of +112 by 64 and 128; when enabled (+68, +72), the engine is idle, the game state is 7 and timer +116 is zero, show the sprite (+28), read the level of the object behind handle +64 and write its origin, scale (1, level), colour, offset and size properties, otherwise hide it and clear the visible byte.
